cp1.title: Which area in Naha is good for relocation research?
cp1.content: I want to stay for about a month and get a feel for the city. I'd love recommendations with good access and easy day-to-day living.

replies.r1: The Kencho-mae and Asato areas are convenient and have many daily-life facilities. A mid-term stay is a great way to explore.

cp2.title: Three coworking spaces in Okinawa City that were easy to use
cp2.content: After using them for a month, these were the easiest places to work from. I picked them based on power access and seating comfort.

cp3.title: Chatan is amazing for beach lovers!
cp3.content: Stayed at the Chatan townhouse for 2 weeks. Sunset views and easy access to cafes were perfect.

cp4.title: Are there good places to stay with children?
cp4.content: I'm planning a one-month stay with my 5-year-old child. I'd love recommendations for calm and family-friendly places.

cp5.title: A quick guide to Naha trash disposal rules
cp5.content: Different kinds of trash are collected on different days, so it helps to check early in your stay. The front desk can also provide the sorting guide.

li1.name: Okinawa Soba Kaze no Niwa
li1.description: A popular Okinawa soba spot with locals. Lunchtime gets busy, but the broth is excellent.

li2.name: CoWork OKINAWA
li2.description: A coworking space with fast Wi-Fi and quiet booths. Monthly plans make it great for longer stays.

li3.name: Weekend Sunset Market
li3.description: A weekend event with local food and crafts. Great for enjoying Okinawa's relaxed atmosphere.

li4.name: American Village Diner
li4.description: An easy diner stop in Chatan with hearty brunch options.

li5.name: Base Camp Chatan
li5.description: A coworking space where you can work with an ocean view. Easy to stop by before or after surfing.

li6.name: Koza Music Festival
li6.description: A live music event held in Okinawa City. Great to enjoy together with an evening walk.
